```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Read in Seurat object of non-haematopoietic cells
# Subset out osteoblasts and chondrocyte clusters
# Ran monocle2

library(Seurat)
library(monocle)
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)

#load Seurat object of non-haematopoietic cells
load("Seurat_object/non_haematopoietic_clean.Robj")

############### Pseudotime analysis of osteoblats lineage clusters #############################

#Subset osteoblast lineage clusters ("3" = MSCs, "7" = Osteoprogenitors, "15" = Fibroblasts, "0" = Pre-osteoblasts, "10" = Mature osteoblasts, "14" = Early osteocytes)
ob <- subset(non_haematopoietic_clean, idents = c("0", "3", "7", "15", "10", "14"))

#Extract data, phenotype data, and feature data from the SeuratObject
data <- as(as.matrix(ob@assays$RNA@counts), 'sparseMatrix')

pd <- new('AnnotatedDataFrame', data = ob@meta.data)

fData <- data.frame(gene_short_name = row.names(data), row.names = row.names(data))
fd <- new('AnnotatedDataFrame', data = fData)

#Construct monocle cds
ob <- newCellDataSet(data,
                         phenoData = pd,
                         featureData = fd,
                         lowerDetectionLimit = 0.5,
                         expressionFamily = negbinomial.size())


ob <- estimateSizeFactors(ob)
ob <-estimateDispersions(ob)

#Find DEGs
clustering_DEG_genes <- differentialGeneTest(ob, fullModelFormulaStr = '~RNA_snn_res.1.2')

#Use top 1000 genes from the clustering_DEG_genes for ordering
ordering_genes_top_1k <- row.names(clustering_DEG_genes)[order(clustering_DEG_genes$qval)][1:1000]

#Order dataset based on significant genes
ob_top_1k <- setOrderingFilter(ob, ordering_genes_top_1k)

#Reduce dimensionality - reduced to two dimensions in this case for visualisation
ob_top_1k <- reduceDimension(ob_top_1k, max_components = 2,
                            method = 'DDRTree')

#Order cells along the trajectory
ob_top_1k <- orderCells(ob_top_1k, reverse = TRUE)

#Plot trajectory without determining root state
pdf("plots/Pseudotime_trajectory_osteoblasts.pdf", width = 6, height = 5.5)
plot_cell_trajectory(ob_top_1k, color_by = "RNA_snn_res.1.2", cell_size = 1) 
dev.off()


############### Pseudotime analysis of chondrocyte clusters #############################

#Subset ostechondrolast lineage clusters ("1" = Resting chindrocytes, "4" = Pre-hypertrophic chondrocytes, "5" = Hypertrophic chondrocytes)
chondro <- subset(non_haematopoietic_clean, idents = c("1", "4", "5"))

#Extract data, phenotype data, and feature data from the Seuratchondroject
data <- as(as.matrix(chondro@assays$RNA@counts), 'sparseMatrix')

pd <- new('AnnotatedDataFrame', data = chondro@meta.data)

fData <- data.frame(gene_short_name = row.names(data), row.names = row.names(data))
fd <- new('AnnotatedDataFrame', data = fData)

#Construct monocle cds
chondro <- newCellDataSet(data,
                         phenoData = pd,
                         featureData = fd,
                         lowerDetectionLimit = 0.5,
                         expressionFamily = negbinomial.size())


chondro <- estimateSizeFactors(chondro)
chondro <-estimateDispersions(chondro)

#Find DEGs
clustering_DEG_genes <- differentialGeneTest(chondro, fullModelFormulaStr = '~RNA_snn_res.1.2')

#Use top 1000 genes from the clustering_DEG_genes for ordering
ordering_genes_top_1k <- row.names(clustering_DEG_genes)[order(clustering_DEG_genes$qval)][1:1000]

#Order dataset based on significant genes
chondro_top_1k <- setOrderingFilter(chondro, ordering_genes_top_1k)

#Reduce dimensionality - reduced to two dimensions in this case for visualisation
chondro_top_1k <- reduceDimension(chondro_top_1k, max_components = 2,
                            method = 'DDRTree')

#Order cells along the trajectory
chondro_top_1k <- orderCells(chondro_top_1k, reverse = TRUE)

#Plot trajectory without determining root state
pdf("plots/Pseudotime_trajectory_chondrocytes.pdf", width = 6, height = 5.5)
plot_cell_trajectory(chondro_top_1k, color_by = "RNA_snn_res.1.2", cell_size = 1) 
dev.off()
```
